recentItems.title: Hall of Fame DB Rod Woodson | NFL Players: Second Acts Podcast
recentItems.description:
Hall of Fame DB Rod Woodson | NFL Players: Second Acts Podcast
 Description: On the latest NFL Players: Second Acts podcast, Hall of Famer Rod Woodson joins Peanut Tillman and Roman Harper for a conversation packed with football history, personal evolution, and the mindset that made him one of the greatest defensive backs ever. Woodson reflects on the humility he carries even as a member of the NFL’s All‑Time 100 team and 75th Anniversary team, he shares stories from Pittsburgh and Baltimore, he opens up about his regret for not running in the Olympic trials, and how broadcasting lets him give fans a true backend perspective.
 
Listen to the podcast here: https://link.podtrac.com/secondacts
